images.concept: Dark editorial composition. A person framed TIGHT from chest up, wearing a solid matte black polo. Subject positioned in the LOWER half of the frame (bottom 55%) — their shoulders touch the bottom edge and their head is roughly at the 40% mark from top. CRITICAL: TOP 50% of the frame is COMPLETELY EMPTY deep black #050505 negative space — no head, no hair, no shoulders, no light spill. The subject's right palm is open at mid-chest level holding a small glowing matte gold square icon with warm #D4AF37 golden glow emanating from it. Background: deep black textured wall, subtle dark concrete texture, no gradient in the top empty half. Camera-left warm directional rim light at #D4AF37 wraps the left jaw and shoulder edge. Shallow DOF, 35mm portrait, subtle film grain. Slight 3/4 left angle. Direct serious gaze into camera. NO TEXT anywhere in image. 4:5 vertical composition.

Dark editorial product shot. A matte black widescreen monitor angled slightly toward camera sits on a dark desk surface. The screen displays a Claude Code agent interface: on the left panel a PNG thumbnail of a dark editorial carousel slide is visible, on the right panel a structured layout plan JSON with gold highlighted keys like 'textColor', 'position', 'safeZone', 'shadow', 'glow'. Thin #D4AF37 golden ruler/grid lines overlay the thumbnail showing safe zones and alignment guides. Beside the monitor: a minimal notebook and a gold metallic pen. Behind the monitor: subtle soft focused deep black texture with a warm directional rim light from camera-left creating a golden glow on the monitor edge. Top 40% clear dark space for headline. No text in image except the faint UI on screen. 4:5 vertical.
